originality.rationale: Jacobs supplies the exact general negative-Pólya composition formula and identifies general-tube statistical properties as a challenge. Henze–Holmes covers a one-colour waiting-time moment boundary. The claim does not present either as new; it establishes the sharp multiquota leading constants, terminal-mark asymptotics, exact quota-sum invariance with independence and necessary-and-sufficient rigidity. Searches of public literature and historical mathematical records identified no statement implying this combined theorem; classical literature may contain an equivalent non-obvious formulation.

value.rationale: This natural all-quota reinforced coupon-collection problem had a cited open direction on general-tube moments. The theorem gives an exact positive-moment phase boundary for arbitrary masses and quotas, a sharp constant and identity of the long-wait bottleneck, plus a closed CDF at the symmetric base case. The converse establishes that quota-sum insensitivity is unique among all positive starting mass vectors, a structural classification rather than a small isolated computation.
